newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Sammi up on POSCO decision to buy plant.
newsitem.headline: Sammi up on POSCO decision to buy plant.

text.p: Shares of South Korea's Sammi Steel rose 6.74 percent in Friday's morning trading after steel giant POSCO decided to purchase a Sammi plant, brokers said.
Sammi rose 300 won to 4,750 with 904,210 shares changing hands.
POSCO on Thursday it has agreed to take over a Sammi Steel plant in Changwon and rights to its steel pipe and bar technology for a total of 719.4 billion won ($828 million.
But brokers said the impact would be short-lived as the take-over deal has been already reflected.
Sammi last December announced it was in talks with POSCO to sell parts of its stainless steel business due to recent financial difficulties.
"The purchase amount is less than expected. I believe 5,000 won looks reasonable for Sammi shares," said a Hanhwa Securities broker. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5647
